managedGame.title: War Room
managedGame.enable: Create as a private War Room
managedGame.description: Choose a preset map, then select its pre-positioned units and assign each one to a player. Your membership includes one active private event for up to {{count}} players, with Game Master controls, reserves, command roles, and Full Vision recording.
managedGame.name: Event name
managedGame.seatsHelp: Select a unit on the map, enter the player's username, and assign it. Green markers are already assigned.
managedGame.selectForce: Select a unit on the map.
managedGame.fixedForcesHelp: The map fixes each unit's type and position. The assigned player starts the battle commanding that unit.
managedGame.forceChoiceHelp: Select a force on the map. You can change its composition before assigning the player.
managedGame.managersHelp: One username per line. You are always a co-host.
managedGame.reservesHelp: One username per line. During the battle, replace a player in two taps.
managedGame.invalid: Add an event name and assign at least one player.
managedGame.presetRequired: Choose one of the fixed-roster preset maps for this War Room.
managedGame.forceInvalid: That force is not available for this seat on the selected map.
